broadcastId.description: A unique identifier of x-hoppers broadcast conference. If present x-hoppers application will use broadcast and push-to-talk functionality for the channel.

ChannelMessagingStatus.description: Set when classound refused a reply because the person's messaging window is closed (a 409 on the send). Unset by the next inbound message, which is the only thing that reopens the window.

channels.description: Recent channels with per-user state and last-message preview.

sections.description: Inbox sections with channel counts and unread counters.

InboxChannel.description: Channel item returned by inbox and channel listings. Includes per-user inbox state and last-message preview.

channelId.description: Direct-channel ids are the 8-4-4-4-8 slices of the two member ids. An `a_` member id puts `_` in a slice, so the pattern allows it.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last channel mutation.

channelVersion.description: Channel version. Increments on every channel mutation.

lastActivityAt.description: Timestamp of the last activity. Drives inbox ordering.

pinnedMessageIds.description: Message ids currently pinned at channel scope, newest pin first. Empty when nothing is pinned.

peerId.description: Direct channels only: the other member's user id, relative to the caller. Absent for group channels and for direct channels that do not have exactly two members.

picture.description: The URL of the channel's picture.

pictureColor.description: The dominant color of the channel's picture, represented by a hex value.

broadcast.description: Indicates if the channel is broadcast-only. Default is false.

sms.description: Indicates if the channel supports SMS. Default is false.

mms.description: Indicates if the channel supports MMS. Default is false.

whatsapp.description: Indicates if the channel supports WhatsApp. Default is false.

kiteAssign.description: The unique identifier of the assignee.

autoRecord.description: Indicates if the channel supports auto start recording.

autoTranscribe.description: Indicates if a conference in the channel starts transcription automatically. When absent, clients follow autoRecord, which used to start both recording and transcription.

wizyGuestViewOnly.description: Indicates if external users in this conversation can only join the conference as a viewer with the ability to speak by request. Default is false.

messagingSenderId.description: The business side of the conversation: the Facebook Page ID on Messenger, the Instagram account ID on Instagram, the brand id on RCS. A reply has to name the sender it is sent from. On Messenger and Instagram kite writes it from the inbound event, because the channel id hashes the sender's linked service and not the sender; on RCS the channel id includes the brand, and it is written when the channel is created.

messagingReplyUntil.description: Epoch seconds until which a reply still reaches the person. On Messenger and Instagram this is Meta's 7 day HUMAN_AGENT deadline, restarted by each inbound message; classound applies the tag itself, so this is the one deadline a client has to show. 0 means the deadline is not known, which is what the inbound event carries when the session row was gone before it could be read back; it does not mean the window has closed, so a client reads the window as closed on `messagingReplyUntil > 0 && now > messagingReplyUntil` and shows nothing at 0. Absent on a channel with no reply window.

InboxState.description: Per-user inbox state for a channel: mute and hide flags, unread counters, and read pointers.

items.description: Identifier of an inbox section. System ids: `all`, `direct`, `group`, `external`, `mentions`. Custom ids are user-defined.

mentionUnreadCount.description: Number of unread mentions of the current user.

lastReadVisibleSeq.description: Highest `visibleSeq` the user has read in this channel.

lastReadTimelineSeq.description: Timeline anchor paired with lastReadVisibleSeq: a timelineSeq near the read boundary, so a client can load a bounded message window and jump to the first unread. Exact when the cursor was set from a resolved message (MarkRead with messageId, message.new, member add, repair, or a tail read); best-effort on the legacy visibleSeq-only MarkRead and unreadMarkAt MarkUnread paths, where the prior value is retained and may lag or lead lastReadVisibleSeq. Absent until the cursor is first written. Treat as a positioning hint, not an exact bound.

lastReadAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent read event.

hidden.description: True when the channel is hidden (archived).

muted.description: True when the channel is muted.

mutedUntil.description: Expiry timestamp for a temporary mute.

pinned.description: True when the user has pinned this channel.

pinnedAt.description: When the user pinned this channel, stamped once at pin time and unchanged by later activity. Absent whenever `pinned` is false, and on the rare pinned row whose pin instant predates pin-time sort ordering.

unreadMarkAt.description: `visibleSeq` from which the user manually marked the channel as unread.

LastMessagePreview.description: Preview of the most recent visible message in a channel.

text.description: Text body of the message. Absent for attachment-only or deleted messages.

pollId.description: Poll identifier when the message is a poll, so a preview can be rendered as one. Absent for a deleted message; the poll body is not stored.

event.description: System event identifier for client rendering.

lastReadVisibleSeq.description: Optional explicit read pointer. Defaults to the latest visible message.

messageId.description: Message the user read up to. Authoritative when present: resolves both the read pointer (its visibleSeq) and the timeline anchor (its timelineSeq).
Message id used to resolve the unread mark position.

unreadMarkAt.description: Explicit unread mark position. Takes precedence over `messageId` when both are supplied.

MessagingChannel.description: A customer messaging channel that reaches x-bees through classound and is not SMS or WhatsApp. One discriminator instead of a boolean per channel, so a new channel adds a member here and not a set of channel fields. An RCS conversation is not a telephony channel, and its customer id is the person's phone number.

mutedUntil.description: Temporary mute expiry. Omit for indefinite mute.

Section.description: Inbox section with metadata, channel count, and unread counters.

sectionId.description: Identifier of an inbox section. System ids: `all`, `direct`, `group`, `external`, `mentions`. Custom ids are user-defined.

channelCount.description: Total channels assigned to this section.

unmutedUnreadChannelCount.description: Unmuted channels with at least one unread message.

unmutedUnreadMessageCount.description: Total unread messages across unmuted channels.

mutedUnreadMessageCount.description: Total unread messages across muted channels.

unreadMentionCount.description: Unread direct mentions of the current user.

SectionType.description: Whether the section is system-managed or user-defined.
